name: Bossy Bulk Editor for WooCommerce
author: bossyplugins1

sections.description:
You didn’t open a shop to spend your afternoon clicking through products one by one. Bossy puts your whole catalog in one screen — filter, search, edit inline, and run bulk actions without opening a single product page.

Every write is snapshotted before it runs. Made a mistake? One click to undo. No developer, no panic, no fixing 80 rows while your store is live.

What’s included — free, no account required

  • Paginated product grid with search, filters (category, type, status, shipping class), and column visibility controls
  • Inline editing for titles, SKUs, status, regular price, sale price, weight, dimensions, stock, categories, tags, shipping class, and short/long descriptions
  • Per-row save and Save All — changes never apply until you confirm
  • Bulk actions: categories (add/set/remove), tags (add/set/remove), price adjustments (set/% /amount), sale dates, scheduled publish date, package fields, stock quantity, sequential SKU scheme, and short-from-long description copy
  • Variation editor — expand any variable product inline, edit price, SKU, stock, weight, and images per variation without leaving the grid
  • Click-to-assign variation image controls
  • Undo snapshot capture and restore for all supported bulk and write actions — no product cap, no undo limit
  • Column visibility picker with persisted state

A separate commercial package (hosted outside wordpress.org) adds:

  • Find & Replace across key text fields
  • CSV Export (filtered / selected / all, choose your field set)
  • Inline Attributes Editing in the grid
  • Bulk Clone / Duplicate products
  • Media Manager — manage product galleries from one screen
  • CSV Import with visual column mapping and Etsy/Shopify auto-detection
  • Gallery & Storefront Settings — four layout presets, thumbnail controls, variation galleries
  • Variations tab — flat grid of every variation with search and filters; bulk apply price, stock, sale dates, shipping, and images without expanding parent rows
  • Variation drag-and-drop image assignment
  • Customer personalization fields (engraving, custom text — carries through to orders)

Details at bossyplugins.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Bossy Bulk Editor for WooCommerce from the WordPress.org plugin directory, or upload the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Bossy Bulk Editor (Bulk Editor tab). Use the Get Pro tab if you want details on the separate commercial package at bossyplugins.com.

You need the edit_products capability to use the Bulk Editor grid.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin fully functional without a paid plan?

Yes. Everything in the wordpress.org package works after activation — no license key, no account required. The Bulk Editor grid, all inline editing, all bulk actions, variation editing, and undo snapshots are all included and fully functional.

What does the separate commercial package add?

The commercial package (sold at bossyplugins.com, hosted outside wordpress.org) adds Find & Replace, CSV Export, CSV Import, Media Manager, Gallery Settings, the Variations tab (flat variation grid with bulk apply), Inline Attributes Editing, Bulk Clone, drag-and-drop variation images, and customer personalization fields. None of that code is in this wordpress.org package.

Does this work with my theme?

Bossy’s Bulk Editor grid runs entirely in wp-admin and is not theme-dependent. It is tested against Blocksy, Kadence, Astra, Storefront, and Twenty Twenty-Five.

Does this plugin connect to any external service?

The wordpress.org package does not bundle a licensing SDK or require an account. The in-plugin Get Pro tab links to bossyplugins.com for the separate commercial package. No data is sent to third parties unless you install that package or follow an external link.

How do I bulk edit variation prices?

Click the variation toggle (the “vars” badge) on any variable product row to expand it inline. Each variation gets its own price, sale price, SKU, stock, and image controls. Edit and save without leaving the grid.

I’m moving from Etsy (or Shopify) to WooCommerce — can Bossy help?

Yes. The Pro package includes a CSV Import tool that auto-detects Etsy and Shopify export formats and maps columns for you. Upload your Etsy listings export, confirm the field mapping, and your products land in WooCommerce without manual reformatting.

The free package handles everything after import: bulk price updates, stock management, variation editing, and undo if anything goes wrong. Makers running handmade or small-batch catalogs are exactly who Bossy was built for — it started as a fix for a 200-product handmade shop before it became a plugin.

Does Bossy support scheduled publishing?

Yes — use the Schedule Publish bulk action to set a future publish date on selected products. Undo snapshot support is included.

Where do I get support?

Post in the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin, or visit bossyplugins.com for documentation and commercial support.
sections.changelog:
1.10.7

  • Variation main image slot now shows assigned images when you first expand a variable product, with a visible + cue when the slot is empty (Free and Pro expanded cards).
  • Variation main image and gallery assignments stay in sync after save, collapse/expand, and in-grid edits — fixes blank main slots and galleries that looked empty right after click-to-pick or drag-and-drop.
  • Pro Variations tab: bulk row selection and apply controls work again when filtering or selecting variations.
  • Clearer on-screen feedback when a variation gallery save fails from the grid.

1.10.6

  • Variation cards now load image state from variation-native media values, preventing parent featured-image inheritance from appearing as variation gallery content when no variation media is assigned.
  • Adds a new Clear all variation images action in the expanded variation panel toolbar (per product row) for both free and Pro workflows.
  • Clear action now wipes variation main image plus variation gallery assignments (including attribute gallery slots) without touching parent product gallery media.
  • Improves clear-action UX with busy state messaging while the clear action runs.

1.10.5

  • Improves variation and gallery workflow reliability across modern WooCommerce themes.
  • Refines undo and bulk-edit behavior for safer day-to-day catalog updates.
  • Polishes admin messaging and release metadata for a cleaner merchant-facing experience.
  • Bulk actions now keep edits in place instead of forcing a grid reload, including sort-aware SKU updates while SKU ascending/descending filters are active.
  • Adds focused automated E2E coverage for in-place bulk actions across free and pro environments.

1.10.4

  • Adds a Settings toggle to enable Bossy diagnostics logging without code edits.
  • Introduces a shared structured logger for key runtime paths (schedule publish, row save, undo restore).
  • Logging can write to debug.log when enabled and supports optional Woo logger forwarding via filter.

1.10.3

  • Bulk schedule publish: hardened minute-level datetime handling so current-minute scheduling does not fail as “not in the future.”
  • Bulk schedule publish: explicitly re-queues core publish_future_post events for selected products to improve reliability on cron-driven hosts.
  • Admin watchdog: adds a Bossy warning when scheduled products are overdue (stuck in future) with actionable cron guidance.

1.10.2

  • Bulk grid: sorting by SKU keeps products with blank or missing SKUs in the list (blanks first when ascending, last when descending).
  • Bulk grid: stock column populates the current quantity from edit context and stored meta, even when Track stock is unchecked.
  • Variation cards: collapsed header no longer shows a duplicate gallery thumbnail next to the featured image.
  • Snapshot restore: bulk SKU scheme and other batch SKU writes revert correctly when sequential assignments swapped SKUs across selected rows.
  • Snapshot undo: Save all and row save produce one undo entry per save (parent + variations grouped), not one per field/row AJAX call.
  • Bulk schedule publish: tightened datetime handling for minute-level inputs and explicitly re-queues core publish_future_post events so scheduled products publish reliably on cron-driven hosts.
  • Free and Pro packages share these bulk-editor grid fixes.

1.10.1

  • Sequential SKU scheme: start number is right-padded to digit width (e.g. start 4 + 4 digits → PREFIX-4000, not PREFIX-0004).
  • SKU scheme preview in the bulk editor matches server apply logic.

1.10.0

  • Variation editor now includes click-to-assign image controls per variation — no separate screen needed.
  • Snapshot undo covers all supported bulk and inline writes with no product cap and no undo limit.
  • Sequential SKU scheme supports prefix, start number, digit width, and separator — variable-product-aware.
  • Short-from-long description copy action auto-fills short descriptions from the first 3 sentences of long descriptions.
  • Bulk sale dates action includes force-off to clear active sales across a selection.
  • Scheduled publish date bulk action added with full undo snapshot support.
  • Column visibility picker state persists across sessions.
  • Performance and reliability improvements for large-catalog workflows.

1.9.0

  • Expanded catalog editing and variation workflow improvements for growing WooCommerce stores.
  • Continued separation between the free directory build and the commercial Pro package.
